Abstraction is powerful but complex to use properly.

Language itself, may be divded into 2 parts: 
- Essential Communication: Sounds (phonemes), Words (grammar)
- Logical Communication: affords reasoning with the abstract substrate itself; i.e., not present in the natural world. This is made possible by the Human ability to reason, think and imagine in abstract space; it is an ability inherit to us, not an affordance of the tool.
